text.8a2df1b2214f4e9c1123: Assistant-authored educational base-case judgments, not company guidance, analyst consensus, investment recommendations or price targets.
text.1a1a611af442b36cd31e: These defaults apply only to a fresh or explicitly reset current-company draft matching the named snapshot. Existing user edits and historical/frozen experiments must not change.
text.814b5158d49947107669: Except for the documented AAOI staged profile, year 1 uses growth, then annual growth fades linearly to terminalGrowth in year 10. It is not a constant ten-year CAGR. Economic checks show the resulting size and CAGR.
text.10cc194761c0a34a3715: Except for the documented AAOI staged profile, reported baseline EBIT margin fades linearly to targetMargin by year 10, except an explicitly disclosed starting-EBIT normalization. Target margin is operating EBIT after ongoing R&D, SBC and depreciation, not gross margin, EBITDA or an adjusted EPS margin.
text.86d769060728eb471aa4: Net reinvestment = max(0, change in revenue / salesCapital). Ratios are independent forward judgments, not mechanically copied from total sales/book-capital or capex/sales. Gross maintenance capex, R&D capitalization and replacement cycles are not separately modeled.
text.c550f51b5566fa346d83: Normalized blended operating cash-tax estimates apply to positive EBIT only. Reported accounting effective rates are evidence, not marginal cash-tax forecasts; tax-loss carryforwards are not modeled.
text.27d26d2ece97aa7e5a44: WACC is an assumed nominal required return, never issuer-reported. Use observed USD Treasury 5.09% on 2026-10-16, an explicitly chosen 4.5% equity premium informed by January 2026’s 4.23% estimate, and assumed beta, target market-value debt weight and debt spread. The January premium is not an October observation. Round model WACC to 0.5 percentage points; betas and weights are not measured live. TSM uses a separately disclosed assumed currency conversion.
text.dc997caeb12b2b4eb4a5: Stable growth is modest nominal growth in the model currency, below WACC and terminal ROIC. Terminal reinvestment/NOPAT = g/ROIC. Mature returns normally fall from explicit-period productivity; a discrete year-11 transition remains a simplification.
text.48c9ae507458a331a5c6: otherClaims=0 and otherAssets=0 are unreviewed numerical placeholders, not verified absence or fair values. No reviewed flags, financing reconciliation or share conversion is implied. Explicit specialist and claim-related gates take precedence over these defaults.
text.baad4bb77e31406aacb2: Deterministic operating-path checks and lower/higher operating cases are model sanity tests, not calibrated probabilities. No stock price or future return is used to choose assumptions.
text.3817592b1783ec43aa2e: Primary issuer releases and exact current filing sources available by 2026-10-17 anchor judgments. Historical annual data are latest-reported context and may include recasts; structural breaks are disclosed.
text.b9acd2e27fa7a5985764: AAOI fresh research uses the documented staged capacity profile. Growth/margin progression and capital-intensity terminal fade are applied to every deterministic and simulated case. Other companies retain the original linear transition.
